module origen_068075 (
    input [7:0] diff_ptr,
    output reg full_flag,
    output reg empty_flag,
    output reg almost_empty,
    output reg almost_full,
    output reg half_flag
);

initial begin
    full_flag = 0;
    empty_flag = 0;
    almost_empty = 0;
    almost_full = 0;
    half_flag = 0;
end

always @(*) begin
    case (diff_ptr)
        8'b00000000: begin
            empty_flag = 1;
            almost_empty = 1;
            full_flag = 0;
            almost_full = 0;
            half_flag = 0;
        end
        8'b11111111: begin
            full_flag = 1;
            almost_full = 1;
            empty_flag = 0;
            almost_empty = 0;
            half_flag = 0;
        end
        8'b01111111: begin
            half_flag = 1;
            full_flag = 0;
            empty_flag = 0;
            almost_empty = 0;
            almost_full = 0;
        end
        8'b11111000,
        8'b11111001,
        8'b11111010,
        8'b11111011,
        8'b11111100,
        8'b11111101,
        8'b11111110: begin
            almost_full = 1;
            full_flag = 0;
            empty_flag = 0;
            almost_empty = 0;
            half_flag = 0;
        end
        8'b00000001,
        8'b00000010,
        8'b00000011,
        8'b00000100,
        8'b00000101,
        8'b00000110,
        8'b00000111: begin
            almost_empty = 1;
            full_flag = 0;
            empty_flag = 0;
            almost_full = 0;
            half_flag = 0;
        end
        default: begin
            full_flag = 0;
            empty_flag = 0;
            almost_empty = 0;
            almost_full = 0;
            half_flag = 0;
        end
    endcase
end

endmodule

module test;
    reg [7:0] diff_ptr;
    wire full_flag, empty_flag, almost_empty, almost_full, half_flag;

    flagset uut (
        .diff_ptr(diff_ptr),
        .full_flag(full_flag),
        .empty_flag(empty_flag),
        .almost_empty(almost_empty),
        .almost_full(almost_full),
        .half_flag(half_flag)
    );

    initial begin
        $monitor("diff_ptr=%d, full=%b, empty=%b, almost_empty=%b, almost_full=%b, half=%b",
                 diff_ptr, full_flag, empty_flag, almost_empty, almost_full, half_flag);

        diff_ptr = 0;   // Empty condition
        #10;
        diff_ptr = 255; // Full condition
        #10;
        diff_ptr = 127; // Half-full condition
        #10;
        $finish;
    end
endmodule
